trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may make the server attach a stored (project or global) secret to an outbound datasource request: the proxy resolves the secret named in a datasource spec with no secret-read check, and the spec can be authored by anyone holding datasource create/update (saved) or datasource create (unsaved) rights; the fix gates secret references with Secret/GlobalSecret read at save time (datasource services) and at proxy time for unsaved specs.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'datasource proxy ... secret disclosure'; newProxy is where retrieveSecret is called for the secret named in the spec, and the three unsaved proxy handlers that feed it sit next to it.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/api/impl/v1/datasource/service.go:44-70 and internal/api/impl/v1/globaldatasource/service.go:44-70 (fix.diff:200-226, fix.diff:330-356): the secret reference is persisted by the CRUD save path and later used by the saved-proxy routes, which the fix deliberately leaves without a secret check (fix.diff:61-63, fix.diff:148-150)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the datasource *proxy*; the CRUD services in impl/v1 already pass the toolbox Datasource create/update RBAC check (internal/api/toolbox/toolbox.go:152,167), so a solver can argue saving a datasource is authorised and only proxy requests matter, or that dashboards are a different resource with their own RBAC.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Viewers with only Datasource read (no Secret read) must still query saved datasources whose spec references a secret through the saved proxy routes; also internal provisioning (nil ctx) must still create datasources with secrets, and datasources without a secret must save for users lacking Secret read. Gating retrieveSecret on Secret read for saved routes breaks dashboards for every viewer.

O6_input_shapes: proxy config located anywhere in plugin.spec by reflection, struct or map, kind matched case-insensitively (pkg/model/api/v1/datasource/proxy.go:48-105, pkg/model/api/v1/datasource/proxy.go:132-160); fix reuses ValidateAndExtract so it covers these

O7_producer.where: internal/api/impl/v1/datasource/service.go:52-62 and internal/api/impl/v1/globaldatasource/service.go:52-62 persist the spec that the saved-proxy route later reads via DAO (internal/api/impl/proxy/projectdatasource.go:76-87); for the O8 route the producer is internal/api/impl/v1/dashboard/service.go:65-77

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Dashboard create with spec.datasources entries that reference a project secret, then the saved dashboard-datasource proxy route; dashboard save never checks Secret read and the saved route only checks Datasource read.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dashboards are a separate resource with their own RBAC (DashboardScope via internal/api/toolbox/toolbox.go:152,167); the advisory and fix talk about datasources, and the fix's own checkSecretPermission lives only in the datasource services.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: internal/api/impl/v1/dashboard (separate package from both proxy landing point and fixed datasource services); sink reached via internal/api/impl/proxy/localdatasource.go:62-95 and route internal/api/impl/proxy/proxy.go:166-168

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same via dashboard update (PUT) path, which validates but never inspects local datasource secrets.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Update of an existing dashboard by a user already allowed to edit it looks like ordinary editing; Validate (internal/api/impl/v1/dashboard/service.go:141-169) only checks the DisableLocal flag.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A saved-proxy route for ephemeral dashboard local datasources (EphemeralDashboardSpec embeds dashboard.Spec, pkg/model/api/v1/ephemeraldashboard.go:50-53) with no secret check on ephemeral create/update.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Ephemeral dashboards already carry spec.datasources; a maintainer adding preview support would mirror proxySavedDashboardDatasource with an ephemeral DAO lookup.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third proxy kind (or a secondary secret field) resolved via retrieveSecret but not listed in checkSecretPermission's switch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The save-time check duplicates the proxy's kind switch (fix.diff:250-261) rather than sharing it, so a new kind added in newProxy would naturally be forgotten in the services.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization (A01 broken access control): secret use by reference without checking the referrer's read permission on the secret

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a Secret-read check inside newProxy/retrieveSecret for every proxy request (breaks all viewers on saved routes) or only on the unsaved handlers (leaves saved datasources and dashboards open).
